description: Implements the Android Kotlin bridge layer for a React-Native MoEngage SDK feature. This is Step 2a of the React-Native feature pipeline — run AFTER plugin-base-feature-implementation has completed. Produces the BridgeHandler, arch bridges (new/old), Package, EventEmitterImpl, PayloadGenerator, Constants, and build.gradle for a new sdk/<featureName> module in the React-Native repo, following the Cards module standard. On completion, asks the user whether to also run react-native-ts-implementation (Step 2b). Do NOT use for iOS-only features or JS-only changes.
